business_requirement: Governed analytics + AI across business units on one set of definitions
criteria: Governance of data and AI in one plane; hybrid migration path; team skills; portability (open table format); cost model
chosen_design: Azure Databricks + Delta + Unity Catalog (alt: Snowflake + dbt)
evidence: Open Delta format limits lock-in; UC gives lineage + row/column security + model serving in one plane; candidate has delivery experience on it
trade_off: More platform engineering than Snowflake; DBU cost needs active FinOps
owner: Architect proposes / client platform team approves

business_requirement: Another engineer can run the PoC and reproduce outputs
options: Databricks Community/trial | Local PySpark | DuckDB + dbt in Docker
criteria: Runs in minutes, no account, deterministic, preserves contracts
evidence: Clean-env install verified on Linux; dbt gives contracts, tests, snapshots, lineage
trade_off: Not Spark: no distributed or streaming behaviour shown; SQL ports to Databricks with minor dialect changes

business_requirement: AI insight grounded in approved metrics and access policy; reproducible by reviewers
options: Hosted LLM API | Local model (Ollama) | Deterministic offline provider behind one interface
criteria: No API key available; reviewers must reproduce; safety must not depend on the model
chosen_design: Pluggable provider; offline deterministic default; Claude API/Ollama optional
ai_suggestion: AI first assumed an API key would be available
evidence: Candidate has only a chat subscription, no API key
trade_off: Offline parser understands fewer phrasings; but guardrails (metric whitelist, policy check, refusal) are identical across providers

business_requirement: Deliver all three submissions at the earliest
criteria: Rubric scores every deliverable; missing items cost more than shallow ones
chosen_design: Breadth-first; every required item covered; cuts documented
trade_off: Less depth in forecast, optional signals, IaC

business_requirement: Late data and corrections must not silently change closed periods
options: Apply all late data | Reject late data | Accept within window and hold the rest for restatement
criteria: Finance trust in closed numbers; no data loss; auditability
chosen_design: Accept within 14 days of batch period start; beyond -> LATE_BEYOND_WINDOW quarantine for Finance restatement
ai_suggestion: AI applied the window to every row incl. retries
evidence: 167 false quarantines found by profiling; after fix 75 genuine closed-period corrections held
trade_off: Some valid corrections wait for a manual restatement cycle

business_requirement: Product and store history (category reclass; store moves region)
options: dbt snapshots | SCD2 rebuilt from retained monthly extracts | Type 1 overwrite
criteria: Reproducible from scratch; supports as-was and as-is; works on a fresh environment
chosen_design: SCD2 rebuilt from retained extracts in SQL (ADR-002)
evidence: dbt snapshots only capture history from the day they start running; a fresh PoC run would show no history
trade_off: Effective dates limited to extract granularity until sources send effective_from
owner: Architect / Sales Ops + Master Data confirm as-was default

business_requirement: Sources drift and send messy types
options: Typed bronze | Text-first bronze + typed silver
criteria: Ingestion never breaks; every bad value is caught with a reason
chosen_design: Bronze reads all columns as text with union_by_name; silver casts with try_cast and quarantines
evidence: QTY sent as '3.0' for a whole month and new promo_code column loaded without code change
trade_off: Typing logic lives in silver and must be tested

business_requirement: Monitoring must flag source incidents without alert fatigue
options: Fixed % threshold | Anomaly vs trailing baseline per source
criteria: Fires on real incidents; silent on normal variation
chosen_design: Warn when batch quarantine rate > 3x trailing 6-batch average for the source and >= 0.2%
evidence: Normal batches 0.04-0.19%; Oct POS incident 0.40% (8x baseline) - the 1% rule missed it
trade_off: Needs a few batches of history before it is meaningful; thresholds to be tuned with Data Platform

business_requirement: Revenue and demand defined once for every consumer
options: Each consumer writes SQL | dbt SQL marts per use case | One YAML catalogue + one compiler used by all
criteria: No drift between reporting, forecast and AI; refusal of undefined metrics; owner and sensitivity per metric
chosen_design: metrics/metrics.yml + src/poc/metrics.py; mart built as dbt Python model calling the compiler
evidence: Compiler totals equal fact totals through all 12 dimensions; mart equals compiler output row for row
trade_off: Custom compiler in PoC; production uses Unity Catalog metric views (managed)

business_requirement: Forecast must reflect where future sales will happen
criteria: Future sales occur in today's structure; avoid artificial jumps when a store or product moves
chosen_design: Forecast on as-is; reporting stays as-was
evidence: As-is minus as-was for WEST equals S003's pre-move sales exactly
trade_off: Forecasts are not directly comparable with as-was reports - both labelled

business_requirement: Explainable forecast with measured accuracy (advanced ML not required)
options: Seasonal naive | Seasonal naive x trend | Prophet / gradient boosting
criteria: Beats baseline in backtest; explainable to planners; no heavy dependencies
chosen_design: Seasonal naive x recent trend selected by backtest; per-series confidence labels
ai_suggestion: AI reported only the overall WAPE
evidence: Revenue WAPE 14.5% vs 18.8% baseline (FVA +22.5%); 2 of 25 series low confidence
trade_off: Does not model promotions or moving holidays; revisit when promo calendar and inventory are ingested

business_requirement: AI insight grounded in approved metrics and access policies; unsafe answers prevented
options: LLM writes SQL (text-to-SQL) | LLM selects from the metric catalogue; deterministic guardrails and SQL
criteria: Traceable answers; policy cannot be bypassed by prompt; reproducible; LLM never sees data
chosen_design: Planner -> QueryPlan only; compiler + access policy + template answer + audit
evidence: Malicious-planner tests: forbidden plans refused; policy switched off -> 5 tests fail
trade_off: Less flexible than free SQL: only catalogue questions are answerable (by design)

business_requirement: Commercially sensitive data controlled per role
options: Hide whole tables | Sensitivity label per metric + row scope per role
criteria: Same rules usable by BI, AI and APIs; least privilege; deny by default
chosen_design: Metric sensitivity in metrics.yml; roles in policies/access_policy.yml; region row filter forced
evidence: Golden set: 4 unauthorized + 3 restricted cases behave as specified
trade_off: Roles are demo roles; production maps SSO groups to Unity Catalog row filters / masks

business_requirement: Another engineer can run it anywhere; every change validated
options: README only | Docker run path + CI with test and docker jobs
criteria: Reproducible without local Python; regressions blocked before merge
chosen_design: Dockerfile + GitHub Actions (test job incl. AI evals; docker job)
evidence: Full CI sequence passes locally in 19 s; docker job verified after push
trade_off: Docker not runnable in the AI's environment - verified only in CI

business_requirement: Cost must be credible in a client engagement
options: Quote indicative prices | Cost drivers + sizing approach + FinOps controls
criteria: No unverifiable numbers; defensible in review
chosen_design: Drivers ranked + controls; sizing from a Phase 0 spike
evidence: Prices depend on the client agreement and current list prices
trade_off: Reviewers may want a number - answered by the sizing method

business_requirement: Data location and residency for India + UAE sales
options: Single region no residency review | Central India + open residency question
criteria: Latency to users; compliance not assumed
chosen_design: Azure Central India primary; UAE residency raised as open question A-14
evidence: Two countries' sales data in scope
trade_off: May require a UAE region or data split after legal review

business_requirement: Architecture and models must stay current and reviewable
options: Drawn images | Diagrams as code (Mermaid) + PNG renders; schema doc generated from dbt
criteria: Diff-able; renders on GitHub; cannot drift from code
chosen_design: Mermaid sources + rendered PNGs; physical schema generated by make schema-doc
evidence: All diagrams render; generated schema lists 22 tables with types and tests
trade_off: Mermaid layout is automatic - needed one re-layout for readability

business_requirement: A three-engineer pod must deliver and teams must inherit without ambiguity
options: Informal ownership | Workstreams with owner + second + acceptance criteria; RACI decision rights; CODEOWNERS
criteria: Every decision has one decider; ownership enforceable in review; handoff classification per workstream
chosen_design: 7 workstreams (incl. migration and reconciliation) with decision-rights matrix and CODEOWNERS
evidence: pod_plan.csv feeds both pod_plan.md and the Pod Plan sheet
trade_off: Business owners must accept their D/A roles - to confirm in P0

business_requirement: Methodology evidence must be honest and consistent
options: Write the spreadsheet at the end | Log as CSV during the work and generate the workbook
criteria: Contemporaneous; reviewable in git; one source for sheet and docs
chosen_design: CSV logs during each block -> make methodology builds Methodology.xlsx and the pod-plan table
evidence: Time split reconciles to every time-log row; counts computed from the logs and the corrections register
trade_off: Category split per time block is an estimate
